name: Notes
description: Notes on the canvas: floating sticky notes in six colors, with a title, free text, a table of key and value rows and a text after the rows (any of them can be left out), to comment on a screen, record a business rule, list the data of an event or leave a message for whoever reads the mapping; and plain text, loose on the canvas or inside a container, for labels, titles and captions, with its own size, weight, color, font family and alignment. Version 6 folds the old Table type into the note. Version 7 adds three decorative types for documentation pages: a frame (outline and optional fill), a bracket and a line.

annotationTypes.name: Note
annotationTypes.description: Loose comment on the canvas (this screen is for X, a business rule, the properties of an event). It can carry a title, a text, a table of key and value rows and a text after the rows; each part is drawn only when filled. It belongs to no screen: it sits on top of everything and neither carries nor is carried by what is underneath. The relation to a screen or an element is an arrow.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short summary of the note; shown in bold at the top of the sticky note. Can be left empty.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: The comment itself, drawn under the title and above the rows. Accepts multiple lines: Shift+Enter breaks the line (Enter confirms while the field is a single line; in the multi-line area, Enter also inserts a line). Can be left empty.

fields.label: Rows
fields.description: One row per record: the key on the left and the value on the right (the properties of an event, the parameters of a call). The order of the rows is the drawing order.

columns.label: Key
columns.description: The name of the data item (a property, a parameter).

fields.label: Text after
fields.description: A second text, drawn under the rows (a remark about the table, a source). Accepts multiple lines. Can be left empty.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: Color of the sticky note: the fill and the text color go together. Empty draws yellow.

values.texto: Only sign up with an approved limit.

annotationTypes.name: Text
annotationTypes.description: Plain text with no frame: a label, a title or a caption, loose on the canvas or inside a container, with optional size, weight, color, font family and alignment. Where it lives is decided by geometry, as for any marking; inside a container it follows the container. Turn Floating on to put it above everything.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: The text itself. Accepts multiple lines: Shift+Enter breaks the line.

fields.label: Size
fields.description: Font size in the component's units (multiplied by the container's density). Empty draws 14.

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Font weight. Empty draws regular.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: Text color: the name of a color token of an applied library (such as on-surface) or a literal color as #RRGGBB. A name that no applied library declares and that is not a color draws #1F1F1F, like an empty value.

fields.label: Width
fields.description: auto: the box follows the text and a line breaks only where one was typed. fixa: the text wraps at the marking's width and only the height follows. Empty draws auto.

fields.label: Family
fields.description: Font family: the name of a font-family token of an applied library (such as font-mono) or a family or CSS stack (such as Roboto Mono). Empty draws font-sans.

fields.label: Alignment
fields.description: Horizontal alignment of the lines inside the box: start, center or end. It shows when the box is wider than the text, as with a fixed width. Empty is start.

annotationTypes.name: Frame
annotationTypes.description: A rectangular frame, solid or dashed, with an optional fill and corner radius: it groups a region of a documentation page (a grid of samples, a section) or, filled, paints a background behind samples. Decorative: it lives in its space, follows its container and never contains other markings, so a sample inside it stays a child of whatever contains the frame.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: Color of the drawing: the name of a color token of an applied library (such as outline) or a literal color as #RRGGBB. A name that no applied library declares and that is not a color draws #79747E, like an empty value.

fields.label: Thickness
fields.description: Stroke width in the component's units. Empty draws 1; 0 draws no outline.

fields.label: Style
fields.description: solido: a continuous stroke. tracejado: a dashed stroke (6 on, 4 off). Empty draws solido.

fields.label: Radius
fields.description: Corner radius in the component's units. Empty draws 0.

fields.label: Fill
fields.description: Fill of the box: the name of a color token of an applied library or a literal color as #RRGGBB. Empty, or a name that is not a color, draws no fill.

annotationTypes.name: Bracket
annotationTypes.description: A bracket beside a group of rows or items: an outline on three sides, open on the side the field names. Decorative: it never contains other markings.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: Color of the drawing: the name of a color token of an applied library (such as outline) or a literal color as #RRGGBB. A name that no applied library declares and that is not a color draws #79747E, like an empty value.

fields.label: Thickness
fields.description: Stroke width in the component's units. Empty draws 1; 0 draws no outline.

fields.label: Style
fields.description: solido: a continuous stroke. tracejado: a dashed stroke (6 on, 4 off). Empty draws solido.

fields.label: Open side
fields.description: The side with no stroke: direita draws "[" (the default), esquerda "]", baixo and cima the horizontal brackets. Empty draws direita.

annotationTypes.name: Line
annotationTypes.description: A straight divider through the middle of its box, along its whole width or height. Decorative: it never contains other markings.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: Color of the drawing: the name of a color token of an applied library (such as outline) or a literal color as #RRGGBB. A name that no applied library declares and that is not a color draws #79747E, like an empty value.

fields.label: Thickness
fields.description: Stroke width in the component's units. Empty draws 1; 0 draws no outline.

fields.label: Style
fields.description: solido: a continuous stroke. tracejado: a dashed stroke (6 on, 4 off). Empty draws solido.

fields.label: Orientation
fields.description: horizontal runs along the whole width, vertical along the whole height. Empty draws horizontal.
